role: post-hoc targeted diagnostic; not a new census or held-out validation
selection_rule: For each gated alloy, take its all-sites MPA0 minimum over seeds 0–29. Reuse existing seeds 0–2 model runs; evaluate one selected decoration for each minimum at seed >=3. Keep all four sites, report target site separately from within-decoration minima.
readout: Verify model bytes, candidate fractions, seed/site identity, clean slab symbols and initial binding index before matched comparisons.
Report each model target eta, four CHE steps, OH/O/OOH chemistry, convergence and all alternative-start energies; never replace target with another favorable site.
Compare all six targets within each model using existing seed0–2 results; report eligibility-specific order and model spread without pooled calibration or rank-validation claims.
Failures remain in denominator; no automatic retry, DFT, expanded seeds or changed integrity thresholds.
